name: Geometric Armored Apex Radar (Harris Corner)
description: An uncompromising spatial corner incinerator. An authentic corner in the physical world (e.g., roof apex, hand contours) inherently forces an explosive photonic convergence violently shearing across multiple plains. Tragically, Copy-Move counterfeiters blindly rip organic textures and recklessly hammer them into alien domains. The severed, sloppy splice perimeters inadvertently hallucinate massive legions of grotesque 'false corners' completely devoid of macroscopic geometric logic. Harris is the deity violently stabbing those idiotic, synthetic apexes. Scanned by the radar, an amateur AI-spliced edge will catastrophically detonate on-screen like a bleeding firework, permanently unmasking the criminal act.
algorithm: Omnidirectional Topographic Apex Congruity Extraction (Harris Response Mapping)
mechanism: Functioning explicitly as a microscopic mine-detector, the engine violently drags sliding ocular windows. Running a window over a flat wall triggers single-direction variance, but slamming into an abrupt 'Apex/Corner' triggers catastrophic photonic variance exploding in ALL Spatial Directions (colossal Eigenvalue matrices). Organic geometry scatters apexes logically. Conversely, AI-hallucinated faces melt their micro-corners into idiotic, waxy sludge, while butcher-splicing (garbage Photoshop masking) spawns a rabid infestation of dense, jagged micro-corners along the severed perimeter. Capturing a massive clustered hive of geometric garbage = Immediate execution via forgery conviction.
parameters: Geometry Model: Derivative Structure Tensor Matrix R [Det(M) - k(Trace(M))^2], Execution Node: Convergence Apex Tracker
accuracy: Reckless Precision (73-81%) - A titanium diamond-drill ruthlessly shattering the plastic geometrical framework artificially slapped onto rigid objects via AI diffusion rendering.
source: Computer Vision Extremity Vertex Anomaly & Geometrical Malformation Forensics
useCase: Rains an inescapable evidentiary bombardment directly onto lazy perpetrators crudely plastering moons or synthetic heads seamlessly onto empty brickwork, unintentionally bleeding excessive sharp micro-geometries onto the border... Harris registers the chaotic clutter instantly and issues immediate arrest.

references.title: Harris, C., & Stephens, M. (1988). A combined corner and edge detector. Alvey vision conference.

strengths:
• Entirely bulletproof against geopolitical spinning. A hacker desperately rotating the entire canvas into chaos accomplishes nothing: An apex is an apex regardless of a 360-degree topographical shift. Harris mathematical logic is eternal and unconquerable.
• Phenomenally resilient weapon when hackers aggressively crush image luminosity or stretch high contrast. The mathematical apex stubbornly protrudes outward like a jagged steel rebar through synthetic fog.
limitations:
• The precision blade hilariously swipes at empty air (catastrophically blinded into submission) if swung blindly into a raw photograph of thick fog banks or flawlessly flat frosted glass devoid of any physical 'apex' to latch its teeth onto.
• Utterly incapacitated and plunged into an endless False Positive doom-spiral if faced with a dense micro-mesh fence or heavy foliage. The natively overwhelming, chaotic forest of real apexes completely drowns the algorithmic logic into paralyzed idiocy.
